actions.action: Lift pot out of bowl, water slowly until it drains, let drain 10 minutes, return to bowl
Empty the bowl of standing water after every watering
Check soil moisture half an inch down every 2-3 days
Water thoroughly whenever top half inch is dry
If light is limited, set up LED grow bulb 6-12 inches above plant for about 12 hours a day
If soil stays soggy or stems turn black and mushy, post a follow-up photo

reason: The answer correctly identifies underwatering but misses the poor soil/pot setup and adds a light problem; its watering advice partly overlaps the fix, but it explicitly says not to repot and dismisses bottom watering, which delays the actual fix.
